verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents support for open table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi) and Iceberg managed tables that store data in customer-owned buckets, which directly supports data portability/exit without lock-in (docs-10, docs-26, docs-57, docs-86, docs-105). However, there is no explicit documentation of a full 'export all data' workflow (e.g., bq extract to Parquet/Avro/CSV for all datasets) or independent confirmation that this is smooth/complete. missing for 10: explicit export/extract tooling documentation, evidence of exporting non-table data (e.g., logs, ML models, metadata) in open formats, and independent verification of ease of full data export.
